run_knn2img_text_to_image: run knn2img.py to generate images from a text prompt using the retrieval augmented diffusion model
run_knn2img_with_neighbors: run knn2img.py with --use_neighbors to include k-nearest neighbor image embeddings from an art database for conditioning
run_knn2img_from_file: run knn2img.py with --from-file to load multiple prompts from a text file and batch generate images
review_Searcher_class: review the Searcher class that loads CLIP embeddings and performs nearest neighbor search using SCANN
review_load_model_from_config: review the load_model_from_config function that instantiates a diffusion model from an OmegaConf config and checkpoint
